description: An eight to one switch whose input is chosen by three gates read as a binary number

inputs.text: The one of the address, adding 1 to the input chosen while it reads above 0V
The two of the address, adding 2 to the input chosen while it reads above 0V
The four of the address, adding 4 to the input chosen while it reads above 0V
One of the eight signals the address chooses between, counted from the top starting at zero, with a light beside it that is lit while it is the one selected

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the eight inputs the three address gates select

notes: with no address gates patched the address is zero and the first of the eight inputs is the one passed

high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
